premise: On a grey morning Butterfly can't fly, her wings are too cold; Bee tries to fan her warm (brrr, colder!) and hums her a sunny tune, Pinecone waits with her, and when the clouds part they both open wide in the sun.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: blowing only makes it colder, and the warmth that works is the one you wait for together.
lesson: Some things can't be hurried, and waiting is easier with friends.
learning: Butterflies warm their wings in the sun before they can fly.

en-US.title: Butterfly Waits for the Sun
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 30s} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] It was a grey, cloudy morning. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Butterfly landed in the grass and tried to fly. {butterfly:shake} Flap, flap… nothing. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] My wings are too cold, she sighed. A butterfly needs warm wings to fly. {bee:enter} Bee came buzzing by. {bee:face happy} I'll warm you up! {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:buzz} Bzzz! She fanned her wings as fast as she could. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} Brrr! That's even colder! [giggles] So Bee {bee:live} hummed her sunniest tune. Still cold. Then along rolled {pinecone:enter} Pinecone. [whispers] When it's cold, I wait for the sun. So they waited. {butterfly:live hold} Butterfly folded her wings. Come out, sun, they whispered. Come out, sun. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} And out it came, warm and golden. {butterfly:live resume} Butterfly opened her wings to the sun. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live hold} Pinecone opened her scales. {butterfly:face happy} Warm at last! {butterfly:go to sky} {sfx:flutter} Up she fluttered, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} and Bee looped beside her. [happily] And on grey mornings after that, three friends sat in the grass together, whispering: come out, sun.

es-ES.title: Mariposa espera al sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 30s} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] Era una mañana gris y nublada. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Mariposa se posó en la hierba e intentó volar. {butterfly:shake} Aleteo, aleteo… nada. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] Tengo las alas frías, suspiró. Y una mariposa necesita las alas calentitas para volar. {bee:enter} Abeja pasó zumbando. {bee:face happy} ¡Yo te caliento! {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:buzz} ¡Bzzz! Le hizo aire con las alas, rapidísimo. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} ¡Brrr! ¡Ahora tengo más frío! [giggles] Así que Abeja {bee:live} le tarareó su canción más soleada. Pero seguía el frío. Entonces llegó rodando {pinecone:enter} Piña. [whispers] Cuando hace frío, yo espero al sol. Y esperaron. {butterfly:live hold} Mariposa plegó las alas. Sol, solito, susurraban, caliéntanos un poquito. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Y el sol salió, dorado y calentito. {butterfly:live resume} Mariposa abrió las alas al sol. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live hold} Piña abrió sus escamas. {butterfly:face happy} ¡Por fin, calentita! {butterfly:go to sky} {sfx:flutter} Y echó a volar, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} con Abeja dando vueltas a su lado. [happily] Y desde entonces, las mañanas grises, tres amigas se sientan en la hierba y susurran: sol, solito, caliéntanos un poquito.

buzz.prompt: a small bee buzzing close by, wings whirring fast, realistic

flutter.prompt: a butterfly's soft wings fluttering, very light and close
